story: Address: 830 Upper State Rd., North Wales, PA 19454 Tel.: (215) 855-0366 (215) 855-0368 Fax : (215) 855-8711 Eastern Dragon gets a private concept homepage, not a mailed pitch. The page keeps their name in the header, puts industry photography in a 4:5 frame, and makes the next step a call or their official site. Nothing here invents hours, a menu, an award, or a person who does not appear in a first-party photo. When harvest can read their live copy, those nouns come back onto the page. When the live site blocks the harvest, the preview stays honest and a little quieter instead of padding fake specifics. The collages stay in the work: people on the job, or food on the plate, never a logo baked into a.
